metadata.target_feature: Continuous Steering Assistance & Driver Override Collaboration

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Assisted Driving v1.1 Section 2.4 (Driving Collaboration) & 3.3

input_context.user_intent: While Lane Centering is actively steering the vehicle along the lane centerline at 72 km/h (45 mph), if the driver manually applies a sine-wave steering input to maneuver around an in-lane pothole without using turn signals, the system must allow manual override with an applied steering torque increase of < 2.5 Nm, smoothly blending assistance without abrupt disconnection or fighting the driver.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Fully marked highway lane, width 3.5 m, straight trajectory

decomposition_targets.description: Blend EPS centering assist during driver evasive input without excessive resistance

formal_requirements.statement: While LaneCenteringActive_flag is true and VehSpd_kph == 72.0 km/h, if abs(DriverAppliedTorque_Nm) exceeds 1.5 Nm during an in-lane avoidance maneuver without turn signals, SteeringCollaborationState shall transition to DRIVER_OVERRIDE_COOPERATIVE and total resistive torque increase shall not exceed 2.5 Nm.
